sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Interactive Audio Chatroom and Companion Social Applications

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Decree 410 of 1971 (Código de Comercio); Ley 526 of 1999 (UIAF); Ley 1121 of 2006; Decreto 1071 of 2015; Resolution 164 of 2021 of the Superintendencia de Sociedades (mandatory ultimate beneficial owner register reporting through RUES); Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Básica Jurídica.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and Incumbency of the foreign direct shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registrar or competent commercial registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia is a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; consular legalization is the fallback for non-member jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney from the direct shareholder to the Colombian incorporator and attorney-in-fact
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the origin jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or national identification and proof of address of each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority and public records of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy apostilled under the Hague Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the foreign corporate shareholder approving incorporation of the Colombian S.A.S.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Official sworn Spanish translation of each apostilled foreign document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sworn translator and interpreter recognized by the Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Translator certification attached to apostilled underlying documents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, shareholders, legal representatives, and relevant payment-rail counterparties are screened against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions, UK HMT sanctions, and Colombian domestic reports issued by the UIAF and judicial authorities. Mandatory enhanced due diligence includes PEP identification (foreign and domestic), adverse media review, source-of-funds analysis, and written AML/CFT risk assessment appropriate to the medium-risk digital voice-streaming application business model.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) through the Cámara de Comercio of the intended corporate domicile, with homologation control by the Superintendencia de Sociedades
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Registered corporate names must be in Spanish, using Latin characters; internationalized brands may be transliterated phonetically into Spanish-compatible Latin script. The name must include the suffix 'S.A.S.' or the full expression 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco / Financiera / Seguros / Fondo / Bolsa (requires prior authorization from the Financial Superintendence of Colombia)
Gobierno / Nacional / Presidencia / Ministerio / Policía / Fuerzas Armadas (requires ministerial or Superintendencia de Sociedades authorization)
Universidad / Academia / Colegio (requires Ministry of Education authorization)
Cooperativa / Mutual / Fondo de Empleados (requires solidarity-economy regulatory recognition)
Cruz Roja / Federación / Internacional (requires proof of lawful entitlement and, where applicable, government license)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición before the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 working days. If denied, a recurso de apelación may be filed before the Superintendencia de Sociedades. Alternatively, the applicant may correct the prohibited or confusing elements and immediately re-submit a new reservation through RUES. If rejection is due to identical similarity, a notarized letter of consent from the prior registrant can support reversal and registration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual registered office is generally acceptable for formation and administrative purposes for a Colombian S.A.S., provided the address is a physically locatable place in Colombia capable of receiving judicial notices, regulatory correspondence, and service of process, and is registered with the Cámara de Comercio. For a voice-streaming app with no material local workforce, the DIAN and Superintendencia de Sociedades may require evidence of actual commercial substance during tax registration or audit; an email-only address is insufficient and creates registration risk.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 20% to 25% quantified likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection during the first fiscal year for a virtual-office digital company; likelihood rises to approximately 35% if VAT obligations, transfer pricing transactions, or in-app payment flows trigger enhanced DIAN scrutiny.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance application and RUES availability/homonym search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the intended corporate domicile
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule of the Superintendencia de Sociedades and Cámara de Comercio tariffs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial recognition of power of attorney and incorporation documents
Commercial registry filing of the S.A.S. incorporation document and RUES enrollment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the corporate domicile
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory commercial registry tariff based on registered capital (minimum capital not required)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille authentication of four origin-country corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority in the country of origin under the Hague Apostille Convention
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-apostille government tariff, estimated at USD 30 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified sworn Spanish translation of apostilled corporate documents and UBO identification papers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Official translator recognized by the Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enhanced UBO, PEP, OFAC, UN, EU, and Colombian domestic sanctions screening and AML/CFT gap assessment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External counsel / corporate due diligence advisor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for medium-risk fintech/social-digital application onboarding; flat fee or blended hourly rate

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime), Articles 1, 5, 13–22 (formation, contents, registration, limited liability); Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971, Articles 98, 110, 113–114, 196 and 372 (corporate registration, legal representation, sole shareholder resolutions); Decreto 1074 de 2015, Article 2.2.2.31.1.2 (registration procedures); Law 2069 de 2020 (one-week company incorporation and digital filing); Law 1429 de 2010 (new-company tax benefits where applicable).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction at the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), operating through the Single Business Registry (RUES) and subject to oversight of the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) filed via the Formulario Único de Registro Empresarial / RUES portal; elevated to a Notarial Deed (Escritura Pública) only where real property is contributed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. Article 5 of Ley 1258 de 2008 allows the authorized, subscribed and paid capital to be freely fixed in the by-laws. None of the subscribed capital is required to be paid at execution, but any paid portion must be deposited into a corporate bank account opened in the name of the S.A.S.; there is no escrow account obligation. For the voice-streaming social app, a registered capital of COP 1,000,000 (approximately USD 250) is commonly declared as sufficient for the object and initial operations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION NO. 001

THE SOLE SHAREHOLDER of [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S., under Article 22 of Law 1258 of 2008 and the by-laws, resolves:

FIRST: Approve the full subscription and initial payment of the authorized capital by the founding shareholder under the incorporation instrument.
SECOND: Adopt the registered office in Bogotá D.C. as the statutory domicile for corporate, tax, and regulatory purposes.
THIRD: Appoint [NAME] as Legal Representative and General Manager with the broadest powers under Article 196 of the Código de Comercio, designating [NAME] as substitute.
FOURTH: Authorize the Legal Representative to complete Chamber registration, DIAN tax registration, and the opening of the corporate bank account.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the proposed registered office via the Single Business Registry (RUES) online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the RUES name-search application with up to three Spanish-language corporate name proposals; the Chamber verifies identity and similarity against existing registrations and issues the Certificado de Homonimia. Reserve the winning name for 30 calendar days (renewable once); the certificate must accompany the incorporation instrument. For a digital voice-streaming app, the corporate purpose should expressly include data processing, online content, and voice/social application services under CIIU 6311.
required_dossiers: Completed RUES name-search application form
Scanned national ID (cédula) or passport of each incorporator
Statement of proposed corporate purpose aligned with CIIU 6311
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar to an existing registration, file an amended request with new name proposals; if a third party opposes, negotiate a coexistence letter or contest the objection before the Superintendencia de Sociedades; if the reservation lapses, request the single permitted renewal within the validity window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Private Incorporation Instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporators and the appointed Legal Representative; Notary Public (Notaría) only where real property is contributed under the by-laws
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize the by-laws in Spanish containing the mandatory content of Article 17 of Ley 1258 de 2008: identification of shareholders, corporate purpose (interactive audio chatroom, voice-streaming social app, IT services), authorized, subscribed and paid capital, administration and legal representation rules, internal governance, and liquidation provisions. The founding shareholder signs the instrument and the Legal Representative executes the formal acceptance of the appointment. If real estate is contributed, the instrument must be elevated to an Escritura Pública and duly notarized before registration.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Homonimia for the approved corporate name
Valid identification documents of all incorporators
Complete draft by-laws text in Spanish
Signed letter of acceptance by the Legal Representative
Municipal land-use certificate for the proposed registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or the Chamber flags a defect, issue a corrective supplement (otrosí) and re-execute the signature; any missing Article 17 clause must be added by an amended instrument before filing; defective signatures are cured by re-authentication before the competent authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Integrated Pre-Registration with DIAN for NIT/RUT Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales, acting through the Cámara de Comercio ventanilla única electronic filing window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the pre-RUT questionnaire during the RUES/chamber filing session; declare the legal entity type as S.A.S., the responsible tax regime (Régimen General), and the principal economic activity CIIU 6311. The system assigns a provisional NIT, which is printed on the registration certificate. After the Chamber registration is completed, the RUT is formally activated without a separate DIAN office appointment.
required_dossiers: Pre-RUT data capture form
Valid identification of the Legal Representative
Declaration of the actual place of business and domicile address
Corporate email address and contact telephone number
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or questions the activity classification, file an RUT modification requesting CIIU 6311 as the principal activity; discrepancies are cured by presenting the final Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal at the DIAN user service desk; no penalty applies for corrections made within one month of incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Formal Registration with the Chamber of Commerce and Issuance of Existence Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the corporate domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) through the RUES platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the executed incorporation instrument to the RUES portal, pay the applicable registration tariff and corporate books registry fee by PSE, and submit the full filing. The Chamber verifies the statutory content, assigns the matrícula mercantil number, and issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, which serves as conclusive evidence of the S.A.S. existence and of the Legal Representative's powers. The corporate books are stamped and registered in the same procedure.
required_dossiers: Executed Documento Privado de Constitución
Provisional NIT / pre-RUT number assigned by DIAN
Proof of payment of the registry fee
Certificado de Homonimia for the corporate name
Valid identification of the Legal Representative
Beneficial owner declaration form, where required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried, the Chamber issues an inquiry notice; the company has ten business days to remedy by submitting an otrosí or written clarification; against a refusal, the incorporator may file the recurso de reposición with the Chamber's registry and, failing that, the recurso de apelación before the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Tax Activation, Electronic Invoicing and Digital Signature
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN electronic services portal (Sede Electrónica) and authorized electronic invoicing software providers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Activate the NIT password in the DIAN portal, register the company as an electronic invoicing issuer under the mandatory facturación electrónica regime, bind an authorized software provider, and apply for the digital signature certificate. Configure the invoicing system to account for Apple IAP and Google Play Billing settlement records and any Colombian VAT on digital services where applicable. Update the final RUT data to reflect active status.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT record with final activated status
Identification of the Legal Representative with signed authorization
Acceptance certificate from the chosen electronic invoicing software provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If electronic invoicing enablement is suspended, correct the implementation report with the software provider and re-submit to DIAN; RUT errors are cured through the online RUT update procedure within one month of incorporation without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Ratification, Banking Capital Deposit and Occupancy Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Sole Shareholder / Board of Directors; commercial banking institution; Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos and municipal Curaduría Urbana
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting to ratify Board Resolution No. 001, record the minutes in the corporate books, and open a corporate bank account in the S.A.S. name into which the subscribed paid capital is deposited. Complete the bank's KYC and UBO forms, file the municipal land-use certificate if a physical office will be leased, enroll staff with ARL/EPS/pension funds before commencement, and request the fire-safety Concepto Técnico from the Bomberos for the office premises.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution No. 001 (ratified minutes)
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT and NIT records
UBO/KYC forms of the banking institution
Lease contract and municipal Uso de Suelo certificate
Corporate books (Libro de Actas) for registry stamping
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the KYC submission, re-present a certified registry extract and the board resolution identifying officers; missing fire-safety items are cured by corrective work orders and reinspection; any municipal land-use objection requires a new use certificate for an alternative address.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board mandate applies to the digital voice-streaming app. Reference authorities: MinTIC (Registro TIC for optional providers of telecommunications/network services), the municipal Alcaldía and Curaduría Urbana for land-use certification, and the Cámara de Comercio for commercial establishment registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no statutory operating or manufacturing permit exists for an interactive audio chatroom/voice-streaming social application. The activity is authorized by the commercial registry certificate (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal); a physical office requires a municipal land-use certificate (Certificado de Uso de Suelo); a provider may optionally obtain the Certificado de Registro TIC before MinTIC if the application is characterized as a value-added communication service under Law 1978 de 2019.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA); for local office premises, Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente (Bogotá) or the competent territorial environmental authority
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category III (no EIA) for software/cloud operations under Decree 1076 de 2015; a full environmental license or environmental management plan registration would apply only if a physical data center or infrastructure facility is installed meeting the Annex II thresholds of Decree 1076 de 2015.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Digital operations generate no process wastewater or combustion emissions; any office sewage must comply with Resolution 0631 de 2015 discharge limits when outside the municipal sewer network; air quality parameters per Resolution 2254 de 2017; electronic waste handled under Decree 4741 de 2005 and Resolution 1512 de 2010.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety technical clearance (Concepto Técnico de Seguridad Humana y Contra Incendios) issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos for the leased office; structural and occupancy compliance certified by the Curaduría Urbana in the applicable land-use/occupancy permit; occupational health and safety clearance under Law 1562 de 2012, Resolution 2400 de 1979 and mandatory employer registration with ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales), together with payroll integration with EPS and pension funds before staff commencement.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – official portal muisca.dian.gov.co and www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Colombian S.A.S. (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada) must obtain a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) through the private Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) registration process. The company must first file the 'Pre-RUT' (Registro Único Tributario) via the DIAN electronic portal (Muisca) or at a DIAN service point, selecting the 'Sociedad' category and indicating the foreign investment status. After incorporation, the S.A.S. must complete the definitive RUT registration, including the address, legal representative, economic activities (ISIC 6311 for data processing and hosting), and the applicable VAT/withholding obligations. For non-resident digital service providers without local incorporation, DIAN requires registration under the special simplified foreign digital services regime, which involves obtaining an NIT for TIN purposes and activating VAT for digital services. In both cases, the NIT is the single tax identifier used for income tax, VAT, and customs purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – the S.A.S. is a Colombian tax resident company subject to national corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta y Complementarios) on worldwide income. The S.A.S. is not a pass-through entity; only dividend distributions to foreign shareholders are taxed as foreign-source dividends at the shareholder level. Nonetheless, the territorial sourcing rules apply to Colombian-source annual income earned by non-resident digital service providers when no local permanent establishment is present.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no check-the-box mechanism. A S.A.S. may elect the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) under Law 1943/2018 if gross revenues are below 100,000 UVT and other statutory thresholds are met, simplifying income tax, VAT, and local taxes. A S.A.S. may also elect pension and parafiscal contributor classifications. For hybrid mismatch purposes, Colombia adopts BEPS Action 2 recommendations and allows limited anti-hybrid alignment; however, no separate transparency election exists for an S.A.S. Foreign digital service providers may elect to be treated as 'sin domicilio en Colombia' for VAT purposes and appoint a local responsible intermediary when required.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Domestic taxable activities generally require VAT registration if gross taxable turnover exceeds 3,500 UVT per year (approx. COP 154 million in 2024). For non-resident digital service suppliers providing streaming, podcast, or audio chat services, mandatory DIAN registration arises when the annual gross consideration from Colombian users exceeds 41,000 UVT (approx. COP 1.8 billion in 2024), regardless of the absence of a local permanent establishment.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Colombia mandates full real-time electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) integrated with DIAN. All VAT registered taxpayers must issue e-invoices through a DIAN-authorized software provider using the standard XML schema and transmit to DIAN for validation before delivery. For credit notes, debits, and debit notes, the same electronic channel applies. Foreign digital service providers under the special regime may issue simplified electronic invoices through an authorized intermediary or via DIAN's web portal without the full local issuer setup. Each invoice receives a CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or, in the case of contingency, a CUDE. No physical fiscal stamp is used; DIAN validates in real time via API-based services. In addition, all calendar monthly filed periodic VAT declarations (F-300) must reconcile electronically with transmitted invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For the S.A.S. exporting services (including voice streaming and remote social app services), zero-rated VAT applies only if: (i) the service is rendered to a non-resident person or entity who is not a VAT-registered Colombian taxpayer; (ii) the service is used exclusively abroad or is in connection with goods exported from Colombia; (iii) the service is covered by a written service export contract; and (iv) the Colombian provider obtains and retains a 'Certificado de Prestación de Servicios al Exterior' or equivalent supporting evidence. The rules for digital services require that the place of use and effective enjoyment be outside Colombia. If a Colombian resident user purchases the voice streaming app through the S.A.S. and the user consumes it in Colombia, it is not zero-rated. Export zero-rating also requires that the S.A.S. be registered as an 'Exportador de Servicios' and that the corresponding export declaration (Declaración de Cambio) is filed for foreign exchange purposes.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación de Servicios (Formulario de exportación de servicios) or electronic equivalent for service exports
Export services contract containing the nature, value, and place of effective use of the service
Certificado de Prestación de Servicios al Exterior signed by the non-resident customer
Commercial invoice in USD or other accepted foreign currency, referencing the NIT and the service contract
Inward remittance certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas) issued by the local bank or exchange office
Valid domestic electronic invoice transmitted to DIAN with export evidence
Customs export declaration for physical goods (for any bundled hardware or physical media) and Bill of Lading / Air Waybill
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Improperly claiming zero-rating on services that are actually consumed in Colombia or without actual export substantiation triggers retroactive VAT assessment at 19%, plus monetary correction interest (intereses moratorios), and fines for inexact returns under Article 648 of the Colombian Tax Code. The penalty for inexact VAT declarations can be up to 200% of the understated tax, and for fraudulent export zero-rating claims, a criminal tax fraud penalty under Law 1943/2018 may apply, including imprisonment and disqualification from exporting for a specified period. DIAN audits export files, foreign exchange repatriation records, and customer location data for digital service enterprises; failure to meet the 180-day FX repatriation deadline may lead to exchange control sanctions, denial of export VAT exemption, and mandatory reimbursement of input VAT previously recovered.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia) holds exclusive exchange-control authority under Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1068 of 2015 (Único Reglamentario Sector Hacienda y Crédito Público) and Circular Reglamentaria Externa DCIN-83 (Régimen de Cambios Internacionales). The regime is operationally administered through authorized Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario (IMCs), i.e., duly licensed commercial banks, which are supervised by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC); the DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) administers the NIT/RUT and maintains the tax information framework that anchors the documentary records required by the IMC declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The COP is fully convertible under a managed float. Current-account flows (service exports, service imports, dividend remittances on registered foreign investment) are liberalized and require only channeling through an IMC plus a corresponding 'declaración de cambio' (Formulario No. 5 for goods/services; Formulario No. 3 for international investments), as opposed to prior administrative approval. Capital-account inflows, including the paid-in capital of a Colombian SAS, require registration as 'inversión extranjera directa' (IED) with Banco de la República through the IMC at or immediately after the transfer date; once the investment is registered, dividends and capital repatriation are freely remittable, subject to documentary verification of the registered investment, auditable reserves, transfer pricing compliance and absence of foreign-exchange infractions. The real hurdles are administrative and evidentiary (timely registration, UBO transparency, matching wire narratives, financial statements evidencing distributable profits) rather than quantitative; there are no statutory ceilings, queues, or quota approvals on profit remittance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Service export proceeds (voice-streaming subscriptions, virtual-coin sales through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, in-app gifting) must be channeled through the Colombian foreign exchange market: the USD settlement received from Apple/Google must be either (a) sold to an authorized IMC, or (b) credited to a foreign-currency account at an IMC or to a previously authorized 'cuenta de compensación' (compensation account) abroad, within six months from accrual/payment. There is no mandatory conversion ratio to COP; exporters may retain USD indefinitely inside permitted accounts, but every inflow must be reported via Formulario No. 5, with the recommended treatment being (i) declaration of the gross export of services (consumer billings) and (ii) simultaneous declaration of the import of app-store distribution/commission services, so that the net USD settlement reconciles with the bank statement. Retaining Apple/Google proceeds in an unregistered offshore EMI, missing the six-month channeling deadline, or imperfectly reconciling settlement amounts constitutes a foreign-exchange infraction subject to administrative fines imposed by the exchange-control authorities and to reputational banking sanctions by the SFC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_regulatory_filing_calendar: Key recurring obligations: (1) timely filing of Formulario No. 5 at each conversion or upon each IAP settlement credited to the IMC account; (2) annual update and maintenance of the IED registration file whenever the capital account, shareholding or valuation changes; (3) quarterly reporting of the compensation account if the SAS validly registers one abroad; (4) annual audited financial statements supporting future dividend distribution; (5) MT103/MT600 supporting documentation retention for a minimum of five years for FX audit purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (COP current account 'cuenta corriente' plus linked USD foreign-currency account at the same IMC; the paid-in capital injection is segregated as a dedicated sub-ledger to function as a de facto capital escrow until registered).
Operational Account (COP current account with USD denominational mirror and foreign-trade desk for Formulario No. 3 and No. 5 filing).
Operational Account (COP transactional platform; limited treasury sophistication for non-resident-invested digital-services exporters).
Operational Account (multi-currency current account and trade desk oriented to technology companies).
Operational Account (wholesale COP current account with global trade solutions).
Operational Account (COP/USD institutional platform; Minimum Viable onboarding only when direct BanCo funding is required).

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for primary treasury use. Domestic digital banks (Lulo Bank, Pibank, Nu Colombia) and SEDPE payment institutions (Nequi, Movii, Dale, Addi) can open COP accounts, but none offers the required foreign-exchange declaration channel (Formulario No. 5), a linked USD account within the IMC framework, or the registered-investment (Formulario No. 3) facility; operational caps and product limitations make them unsuitable for commercial-scale Apple/Google settlement flows. Offshore EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, Mercury, Currenxie) are legally usable only as an auxiliary expense rail (e.g., paying non-resident contractors, SaaS subscriptions), provided payments originate from duly channeled Colombian funds and are declared as imports of services; receiving or parking Apple/Google export settlements in an offshore EMI without a Banco de la República-registered compensation account breaches the six-month channeling rule and triggers foreign-exchange infractions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence in Colombia of the legal representative is the default SFC-regulated pattern for executing the account contract and receiving security tokens. Practical alternative accepted by major IMCs: the sole director grants an apostilled special power of attorney to a locally resident apoderado who appears at the notary and at the bank branch, while UBOs are onboarded via a live videocall with notarized identity packet (passport, apostilled UBO declaration, background check consent). Fully remote opening is available only at a few digital banks that lack FX declaration capability, so the recommended protocol is a single physical visit (Bogotá or Medellín) to the IMC branch to close the account file, followed by fully remote treasury operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: 'companion/voice-chat' business model (ISIC 6311) classified by the bank's internal model as Medium-Risk-Enhanced due to virtual gifting, romance-scam exposure, sextortion and card-not-present laundering vectors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apple Developer Program Agreement and Google Play Developer Distribution Agreement; catalog and pricing of virtual items/coins; refund and chargeback policy; content moderation and automated anti-fraud transaction monitoring documentation; evidence of restriction-and-ban enforcement flows; projected KPI tables showing user-venue hygiene.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: non-resident UBO chain with opaque holding structure and no Colombian substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled UBO declaration with full ownership chain; shareholder register of the SAS; copies of Formulario No. 3 registration or its bank filing receipt; CVs and passport pages of ultimate individuals; board resolutions of the SAS approving treasury policy and designating signatories; explanation of the corporate purpose consistent with ISIC 6311.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: initial capital injection arriving from high-risk jurisdictions or from remitting accounts not in the investor's name.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SWIFT MT103 wires matching the exact registered corporate name and NIT of the SAS; share-subscription agreement; paid-in capital minutes; KYC documentation of the remitting bank and the ultimate signer; audited financial statements (if investor is an entity) evidencing lawful source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: absence of operating history and mismatch between minimal paid-in capital and projected high IAP volume.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month P&L and working-capital forecast; AWS/GCP hosting contracts evidencing real infrastructure; pre-launch user-acquisition agreements; Apple/Google settlement reports (if any); payroll and contractor invoices; cap table and capitalization schedule.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: sanctions, PEP or negative media hits on directors, UBOs or the corporate name.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: World-Check or Refinitiv screening results with case references; negative-hit explanation memorandum; consent forms for background checks; confirmation of non-inclusion in OFAC, EU, UN and Colombian national lists; certificates of good standing from the Cámara de Comercio and DIAN.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) execute share-subscription and related corporate documents; (2) obtain the SAS NIT and Cámara de Comercio registration; (3) open the COP operational account at a designated IMC (Bancolombia preferred); (4) file Formulario No. 3 (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales) through the IMC at or immediately after the disbursement date, obtaining the bank's investment registration reference number and endosing the foreign investor's legal capacity; (5) investor wires SWIFT MT103 with beneficiary name exactly matching the registered corporate name plus NIT (the internal identifier 'CO_SAS' must not appear in the wire), account number, the bank's SWIFT/BIC, and payment narrative 'APORTE DE CAPITAL - INVERSIÓN EXTRANJERA DIRECTA'; (6) upon credit, the IMC tags the transaction with the investment registration code and generates the declaración de cambio; (7) funds may remain in USD in a linked foreign-currency account or be converted spot to COP at the IMC's reference rate; (8) any future capital increase must update the same registration file, and all future dividends and capital repatriations must cite the registration code; the SAS must maintain a permanent per-shareholder paid-in capital sub-ledger.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (a) domestic operating costs via COP account using ACH (Cámara de Compensación), Transfiya real-time transfers, PSE for supplier payments, and electronic payroll through 'nómina electrónica'; (b) international disbursements for cloud computing (AWS, Google Cloud), SaaS tools, and cross-border professional fees via SWIFT MT103 single payments executed by the IMC after conversion or by debiting the USD account; batch contractor remittances through MT101/MT102; (c) each outbound payment must be reported as an import of services in Formulario No. 5 (most IMCs allow aggregate monthly declarations), supported by the underlying invoice and platform contract; (d) documentary letters of credit are ordinarily irrelevant for service-only flows, but the IMC may issue a standby LC or performance guarantee if an app-store aggregator or corporate client requests deposit coverage; (e) all USD/COP conversions are executed T+0/T+1 with the IMC as principal to eliminate private counterparty FX risk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) sold by authorized IMCs, settled in COP, permitted for hedging forecast Apple/Google USD receivables up to 24 months under a board-approved treasury hedging policy
OTC vanilla USD/COP options (call/put) offered by SFC-licensed IMCs, with premium and exercise settlement in COP and a confirmed underlying export exposure
Cross-currency swaps (USD/COP and USD floating-rate vs IBR) with SFC-authorized counterparties documented under ISDA/CSA
Listed USD/COP futures contracts on the BVC (Bolsa de Valores de Colombia) derivatives market for granular tranche hedging if the SAS qualifies as an institutional client

Natural hedging by retaining USD proceeds in the registered foreign-currency account at the IMC and matching USD outflows (Apple/Google commissions, cloud infrastructure costs, international contractor payments) without executing unnecessary spot conversions

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general ICT-sector tax holiday. Preferential regimes: (i) 25% CIT deduction for investments in scientific, technology, and innovation projects (Article 256-1 E.T.); (ii) reduced 20% rate for companies established in Zonas Francas (Article 240-1 E.T.); (iii) renta exenta for certain creative/software services applies only under strict territorial and export conditions and is materially constrained by the 2022 reform.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios; mandatory electronic filing through the DIAN MUISCA portal (www.dian.gov.co) using the 'Sociedades' 2316 electronic signature and authentication.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual income tax return is due in the month of February through April of the following calendar year, on a staggered schedule fixed by DIAN by reference to the last two digits of the taxpayer's NIT; legal entities typically file within the period beginning 15 February and ending 30 April. For FY2024 returns, deadlines ran between 17 February and 29 April 2025.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue (operating and non-operating) accrued during the fiscal year, including in-app purchase proceeds from Apple App Store and Google Play, net of platform commissions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide revenue attributable to the Colombian S.A.S.; a foreign parent has no filing obligation for this line unless it has a permanent establishment in Colombia, and the S.A.S. must not include revenue of the parent group.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2 – Ingresos no constitutivos de renta ni ganancia ocasional
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutorily non-taxable income (e.g., dividends received from domestic holdings under the non-proportional regime and capital returned from third-party settlements).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only apply items expressly listed in Articles 53, 55, and 56 E.T.; foreign-exchange gains on intercompany loans can be classified here only if the loan qualifies as a 'foreign loan' registered with the Central Bank.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs (bandwidth, co-location, voice-stream compute), depreciation, amortization, platform commissions, user-acquisition marketing, and royalties royalties are deductible under Article 107 E.T. on a causal, proportionate and expressly admissible basis.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border management fees and royalty payments to a related foreign entity are deductible only if the corresponding services are real, benefit the local entity, and are properly supported by transfer pricing documentation; otherwise, DIAN will recharacterize and deny the deduction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net ordinary income: gross income minus non-taxable income minus costs, deductions, and exempt income allocated to the ordinary class (cédula ordinaria).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This line must reconcile with the intercompany settlement statements of the group; any reclassification affects the transfer pricing adjustment to be reflected here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after loss set-off; the 12-year carryforward and the 25%-of-taxable-income annual cap apply here.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign parent cannot offset its own losses or carried losses in the Colombian entity; the limitation under Article 147 E.T. is entity-specific.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final corporate income tax at 35% applied to Line 51, before the 25% CTeI discount and other tax credits (foreign tax credit under Article 254 E.T. for withholding suffered abroad on income produced abroad).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No relief is available for the Colombian parent-losses; foreign tax credits are allowed only for taxes paid abroad on Colombian-sourced income attributable to a foreign permanent establishment, which is not typical for a pure digital voice-stream domestic entity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing carries the 'Sanción por extemporaneidad' under Article 641 E.T., equal to 5% of the tax assessed per month or fraction thereof of delay, capped at 100% of the tax due; for zero-tax filers, the fine is fixed in UVT (up to 5,000 UVT ≈ COP 248.9 million for FY2025). Filing with correcting infractions not caused by the taxpayer may trigger 'Sanción por corrección' at significant percentages of the difference in tax, and 'Sanción por inexactitud' at 100% of the omitted tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding on dividends distributed to a non-resident shareholder out of profits that were already subject to corporate income tax (Article 242-1 and Article 408 E.T.). No additional income tax is levied on the foreign parent if the dividend was paid from taxed profits; distributions from untaxed profits are reclassified as taxable at 35% full-rate on the distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Colombia's DTAs (e.g., US, UK, Spain, Chile, Mexico, South Korea, Japan) reduce the dividend WHT to 5% (where the foreign company holds at least 10-25% of voting capital) or to 10-15% in other cases. Protocol to invoke: (i) obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority for the relevant calendar year; (ii) submit the TRC plus an updated 'Certificado de existencia y representación' to the Colombian payer before the dividend payment; (iii) the S.A.S. makes the payment at the treaty rate and retains the TRC in its withholding documentation; (iv) no advance DIAN ruling is required, but the payer must report the application in Form 2276 (Declaration of withholdings) and retain the file for a 5-year audit period; (v) if the foreign shareholder is in a jurisdiction without a DTA, the 10% statutory rate applies on gross payment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT on payments to non-residents: royalty/technology transfer fees: 15% (Article 408 E.T.); contract performance or technical services with no technology transfer: 15%; interest: 15% general, reduced to 5% for loans granted by foreign financial institutions registered with the Central Bank (Banco de la República) under an external credit agreement, or, alternatively, treaty-reduced at 10-0% under applicable DTAs. There is no WHT on dividends if paid out of capital gains or capital reductions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File: mandatory where the Colombian taxpayer's gross income or total assets exceed 100,000 Tax Value Units (UVT) (COP 4,706,500,000 for FY2024; COP 4,979,900,000 for FY2025) and the taxpayer enters into transactions with related parties. Master File: taxpayers belonging to an MNE group that exceeds 20,000,000 UVT of consolidated group revenue must file; a full CbC Report applies to groups with consolidated revenue above 20,000,000 UVT. The informative annual TP return (Form 120) is due to DIAN in the same filing window as the CIT return for all taxpayers meeting the above economic thresholds and carrying out related-party transactions.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Commodity 'sixth method' applies only to commodity transactions
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) in the Gulf-Council style; however, the S.A.S. must maintain substantive local activity to avoid (i) foreign-controlled-company (CFC) attribution to the parent under Articles 881-883 E.T., (ii) recharacterization under the GAAR (Article 869 E.T.), and (iii) lack of 'beneficial use' for treaty reduced rates. The comparative voice-streaming business requires local staff, bank accounts, server contracts, and real board oversight in Bogotá; a passive conduit with an address-only presence is exposed to DIAN reassessment and to 'abusive structure' penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting in-app revenue streams (e.g., receiving Voice Token, subscription, or coin purchases routed to foreign wallets without invoicing in Colombia; deducting false hosting or marketing invoices from shell vendors); supporting false tax invoices (Article 402 of the Criminal Code covers determined evasion and invoicing fraud).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal: 48-108 months' imprisonment and a fine equal to 50% to 200% of the evaded tax (Article 402, Código Penal, as amended by Ley 2277 de 2022). Administrative: DIAN will assess the omitted tax plus 'Sanción por inexactitud' at 100% of the difference (Article 648 E.T.), plus default interest at 1.5% monthly; criminal case must be triggered by a formal DIAN penal complaint.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative is jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax if the company's assets are insufficient (Article 794 E.T.); in criminal cases, the representative's personal assets can be seized, travel bans (prohibición de salir del país) can be imposed during investigation, and a conviction carries imprisonment, plus disbarment from holding directorships for up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The S.A.S. pays excessive management fees, algorithm-licence royalties, or technical-support fees to the foreign parent or to a low-tax IP-holding subsidiary (e.g., a BVI or Delaware IP Co) without contemporaneous TP documentation (Local File, Master File, Form 120), or at margins outside the arm's-length range.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may adjust the price, deny the deduction, apply enactment of the 'Sanción por inexactitud' at 100% of the omitted tax and recalculate transfer pricing penalties; failure to submit Documentation or Form 120 triggers the per-infraction fine under Article 651 E.T. of up to 15,000 UVT (COP 704.6 million for FY2025) and a reduction of the audit limitation period from 3 to 6 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign the Form 120 with false TP information may be jointly liable; the corporate veil can be pierced under the 'abuso de la forma societaria' doctrine (Article 6 Ley 1429/2010 and explicit GAAR tax penalty under Article 671 E.T.), which lets DIAN assess the hidden taxpayer and hold the parent as joint debtor plus apply penal liability for untrue statements (Article 434-Bis Código Penal).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell/Circular Cash-Flow Structure and Beneficial Ownership Non-Disclosure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The S.A.S. is a nominee-controlled, address-only entity with no Colombian payroll, no local ledger, and all substantive functions executed abroad, while invoicing the parent for Colombian digital users; failure to file the annual Beneficial Owner Information (Beneficiario Final) with DIAN or the Registry of Beneficiarios finales under Law 2155 of 2021.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN can impose: (i) for the Beneficiario Final omission, fines of up to 10,000 UVT per month of delay (Article 651 E.T. applied analogically); (ii) for lack of substance, the reattribution of all income to the foreign parent under CFC rules with a 35% tax and a 10% dividend WHT at source in Colombia; (iii) a declaration of 'sociedad simulada' in the commercial registry leading to cancellation of the company's registration and joint liability of the nominee shareholder.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors of the S.A.S. are personally liable for civil restitution of the unpaid tax (Article 794 E.T.), risk criminal money-laundering liability if the circular flow is intended to conceal beneficial ownership (Article 323 Código Penal: 10-30 years), and can be subject to a preventive freezing order and a travel ban pending the investigation.
